caribbean.headline: Roatan Faces Heavy Rain, Moderate Winds Today
caribbean.paragraph: I observe Roatan experiencing 23 kt winds and 5.4 ft waves, with 75% rain probability. Nassau also reports 23 kt winds.

mediterranean.headline: Mediterranean sees calm winds, moderate rain risk
mediterranean.paragraph: Naples is experiencing maximum winds of 9 kt, wave heights up to 3.8 ft, swell period of 5 s, and a 50% rain probability, with dominant swell from the southwest. Venice, the runner up, will see winds up to 12 kt, while conditions remain otherwise mild.
